title: House Passes Online Safety Bill as Senate Eyes Stricter Push
title_zh: 众议院通过在线安全法案，参议院加大力度推动
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The House on Monday passed legislation to require new online safety protections for children, a sign of growing momentum in Washington to address a widespread concern among US parents even as the measure sets up a clash with senators seeking stronger safeguards....
summary_zh: （彭博社）——众议院周一通过了一项立法，要求对儿童采取新的在线安全保护措施，这是华盛顿解决美国家长普遍担忧的势头不断增强的迹象，尽管该措施与寻求更强有力保护措施的参议员发生了冲突。

title: China's Nexchip Semiconductor seeks up to $890.3 million in Hong Kong share sale
title_zh: 中国 Nexchip 半导体寻求在香港出售股票，融资金额高达 8.903 亿美元
summary: China's Nexchip Semiconductor seeks to raise up to HK$6.98 billion ($890.26 million) in a ‌Hong Kong share sale, an exchange filing ‌showed on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 周二提交的一份交易所文件显示，中国的 Nexchip Semiconductor 寻求通过在香港发售股票筹集至多 69.8 亿港元（8.9026 亿美元）。

title: Australia sues Amazon unit over alleged breach via Prime Video ads
title_zh: 澳大利亚起诉亚马逊子公司，指控其通过 Prime Video 广告违规
summary: Australia's competition regulator said on Tuesday it has taken Amazon's Australian unit to court, alleging its ‌Prime subscription contracts contained unfair terms that allowed the company ‌to add advertising to its video streaming platform.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚竞争监管机构周二表示，已将亚马逊澳大利亚子公司告上法庭，指控其 Prime 订阅合同包含不公平条款，允许该公司在其视频流平台上添加广告。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip after tech rebounds
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在科技股反弹后下跌
summary: US stock futures teetered as Wall Street digested an upbeat start to the week.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街消化了本周的乐观开局，美国股指期货摇摇欲坠。

title: Wall Street ends higher as major tech-related shares jump
title_zh: 随着主要科技股上涨，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed higher on Monday, with the Dow adding about six-tenths of a percent to notch a record closing high, the S&P 500 climbing nearly 1.2% and the Nasdaq gaining 2%.Several tech stocks that had fallen recently due to concerns about AI spendin...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一收高，其中道琼斯指数上涨约十分之六，创下收盘新高，标准普尔 500 指数上涨近 1.2%，纳斯达克指数上涨 2%。最近由于对人工智能支出的担忧而下跌的几只科技股...

title: Retail 'FOMO' drives record SpaceX Options volume following blockbuster IPO
title_zh: 零售业“FOMO”推动 SpaceX 期权成交量创历史新高
summary: Henry Schwartz, Cboe VP of Derivatives Market Intelligence joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to discuss how SpaceX (SPCX) options volume exploded on day one, shattering Meta’s (META) previous record with 1.8 million contracts traded.
summary_zh: 芝加哥期权交易所衍生品市场情报副总裁亨利·施瓦茨 (Henry Schwartz) 与雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起讨论了 SpaceX (SPCX) 期权交易量如何在第一天爆炸式增长，打破了 Meta (META) 之前的 180 万份合约交易记录。

title: Tech giants are not going to slash their AI spending plans, bullish tech analyst says
title_zh: 看涨的科技分析师表示，科技巨头不会削减人工智能支出计划
summary: Expect big capital expenditure numbers this second quarter reporting season from the largest tech companies.
summary_zh: 预计最大的科技公司在第二季度财报季将出现大量资本支出。

title: Tech stocks today: Tech stocks gain, Google rises after joining the Dow
title_zh: 今日科技股：科技股上涨，谷歌加入道指后上涨
summary: Tech stocks enter the final few days of the quarter in the aftermath of one of their worst weeks of the year.
summary_zh: 在经历了今年最糟糕的一周后，科技股进入了本季度的最后几天。

title: Why Samsung & SK Hynix are investing so much in South Korea's AI build-out
title_zh: 为什么三星和 SK 海力士在韩国的人工智能建设上投入如此多的资金
summary: Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are investing $880 billion in South Korea's artificial intelligence (AI) build-out. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines the details.
summary_zh: 三星 (005930.KS) 和 SK 海力士 (000660.KS) 正在投资 8800 亿美元用于韩国人工智能 (AI) 建设。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 概述了详细信息。
